request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone asset for the SAME knowledge-city strategy-game civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. Use the image as a strict material and architectural craftsmanship reference, NOT as a silhouette to copy. Warm pale limestone as the main matte mass, broad dark slate ceramic roofs, aged copper-bronze structural eaves and frames with contained turquoise patina, subtle warm amber only in shallow window panes or a tiny lantern. Large calm material regions, warm handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than medieval fantasy or photorealism. City Guild: a wide low pavilion with a deep ground-floor portico. The portico is two or three THICK limestone piers and a heavy copper lintel, not thin columns. Behind the portico, a single broad hall under a hipped slate roof with generous eaves. Wider than it is tall. Windows only as simple shallow framed rectangular recessed panels with thick frames, never perforations. Compact architectural base with no surrounding terrain hex, no stalls, no barrels, no signboards, no tavern mugs. Read clearly as a craft guild hall, not a house, church, castle, market stall cluster or temple. Show the complete standalone subject in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. All walls and roofs 100% closed except the intended deep portico recess. Thick connected structural pieces, no thin railings or filigree, no text, logos, people, gears, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery.
